claims.claim_text: The image-level manipulation score is relatively low (0.378).
claims.brief_justification: Detector numeric output; not verifiable from the photograph.

claims.claim_text: The localized regions with higher probabilities are small and scattered.
claims.brief_justification: Refers to detector localization output; no localization map is supplied and no location is named.

claims.claim_text: This indicates no significant evidence of digital alteration.
claims.brief_justification: No seams, halos or lighting mismatches are visible, but the four giraffe heads are stacked in an unusually regular descending diagonal at similar angles and similar apparent size, which cannot be confidently distinguished from a genuine line-up at a zoo barrier at this resolution.

claims.claim_text: Giraffes are present in the image.
claims.brief_justification: Four giraffe heads and upper necks with clear reticulated coat patterning and ossicones are visible above a rock face.

claims.claim_text: The overall composition supports the conclusion that the image is authentic.
claims.brief_justification: Lighting and shadow direction are consistent across all four animals and the rock, supporting coherence; but the composition's most notable feature - the near-regular repetition of the four heads - is the one element that argues the other way, so citing composition as support is one-sided.

claims.claim_text: The giraffes have a natural appearance.
claims.brief_justification: Anatomy, coat pattern and head/neck postures all read as normal real giraffes.

claims.claim_text: Their environment has a natural appearance.
claims.brief_justification: The environment is coherently photographed but is plainly man-made: uniform sculpted grey artificial rockwork without real stratification or lichen, plus a metal chain at lower right indicating an enclosure. 'Natural' holds only in the sense of unedited, not in the sense of a natural habitat.

notes: The named object (giraffes) is correct and no editing artefact is visible, but the explanation's appeal to composition and natural appearance overlooks both the suspiciously regular stacking of the four heads and the artificial zoo rockwork setting. No specific region is named, so most of the text is unauditable score narration.
